question: Should Discord source-message subagent progress coordinate shared reaction ownership with the status controller, or should overlapping reaction configuration be prohibited?
rationale: Discord exposes one bot-owned reaction per emoji, so two independent controllers cannot safely acquire and remove the same configured emoji without a deliberate ownership contract.

options.title: Coordinate Reaction Ownership
options.body: Add a per-message ownership or reference-count layer shared by status and subagent-progress controllers so each releases only its own claim.

options.title: Reject Emoji Collisions
options.body: Validate progress count and failure emojis against all configured ack and status reactions and reject overlapping configuration.

options.title: Reserve Fixed Progress Emojis
options.body: Remove emoji customization and use a documented reserved progress set that cannot overlap supported status feedback.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Reaction Ownership
recommendation.body: Add a per-message ownership or reference-count layer shared by status and subagent-progress controllers so each releases only its own claim.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord status-reaction fixes and merges make this the strongest available owner for deciding the permanent reaction-ownership contract.
